domain_summary: FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE. Quillfern Tea Co., an invented loose-leaf tea subscription, raises its monthly price from EUR 9.90 to EUR 12.90 with compostable pouches and a fifth pouch every three months.

segments.label: Long-time subscribers
segments.role_description: Subscribers for more than a year who drink tea daily and know the range well.
key_attitudes: Notice any change to the box
typical_motivations: Keep a reliable supply of tea they like
typical_fears: Paying more for the same tea
segments.communication_style: Calm, detailed, compares with past boxes.

segments.label: Price-sensitive subscribers
segments.role_description: Subscribers who joined for the price and track monthly spending closely.
key_attitudes: Compare every subscription they pay for
typical_fears: Small increases that add up over the year

segments.label: Sustainability-minded buyers
segments.role_description: Buyers who choose brands for packaging and sourcing.
typical_fears: Greenwashing used to justify a price increase

segments.label: Subscribers who compare competitors
segments.role_description: Subscribers who tried other tea boxes and may switch again.
key_attitudes: Loyal to value, not to brands
typical_motivations: Find the best tea for the money

rationale: Four equal segments keep the fixture small while covering loyalty, price, sustainability and switching, the four objections the brief asks about.
